title: "Some people call me…" nickname intro
summary: Open with a funny nickname, then show the habit, hobby or product that earned it. AI brainstorms the nicknames and the reveal lines.
why: A TikTok trend guide updated October 8, 2026 lists "Some people call me…" as an October format: you start with a nickname or inside joke, then reveal the reason, often a product or service.
steps: Think of something you're known for: always early, always baking, always fixing things, always lost in a book.
Use the main prompt to get nickname ideas and a short reveal line for each.
Film yourself saying "Some people call me…" with the nickname on screen, then cut to the thing that explains it.
Ask viewers what people call them. Nicknames make easy comments.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: I'm making a "Some people call me…" video. Here's what I'm known for: [always bringing snacks for everyone]. Give me 8 short, funny, kind nicknames that fit, each with a one-line reveal for the second half of the video, like "Some people call me the Snack Concierge… because my bag has never been empty." Keep them family-friendly. No teasing about looks, money or health.

prompts.label: Variation: a friend who agreed
prompts.text: My friend [first name] said yes to being in a "Some people call her…" video. She's known for [planning every trip down to the minute]. Write 6 nickname ideas with a quick reveal line for each, and pick the one that's the most affectionate. It should feel like an inside joke, never a put-down.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run a [type of business, for example: bike repair shop in Calgary]. Write 6 "Some people call me…" openers where the nickname leads into what we actually do, like "Some people call me the flat-tire whisperer… because I fix them same day." Only use claims I can back up: [list 2–3 true things about the business]. No made-up reviews, awards or customer numbers.

tips: Say the nickname with a straight face. The reveal does the work.
Put the nickname on screen in big text so people get it with the sound off.
Keep the whole video under 10 seconds for an easy rewatch.
For a business, the reveal should be true and specific: a real service, a real habit, a real product.
